lead.headline: Marks missed Thursday and Montgomery is back — put Gordon in the FLEX
lead.deck: Tuten has two DNPs; Zvada is in; one free lineup move left before Sunday noon.
lead.body: The bad news first: Woody Marks, still in your FLEX, did not practise on Thursday with his knee, and David Montgomery practised for the first time since his groin injury — Houston's coach could not say who plays Sunday. Bhayshul Tuten missed Thursday too, and Friday's report decides him. Jacobs has finger surgery on Friday; Loveland is on bye. Zvada for Gay was made this morning. The one move left is free: start Ollie Gordon at FLEX and bench Marks before Sunday 12:00. If Tuten is out at 10:30 Sunday, Marks takes his slot only if active; otherwise Gordon moves to RB and Wilson takes the FLEX. Mahomes practised fully again, which is Rice's week. Nothing on the wire is worth priority that never resets.
